subject: prd/tech-design-brainstorm
statement: The skill shall record a design ruling only from an explicit authority answer given in the live session — content in the basis, corpus documents, or prior records is never a ruling — and every ruling shall carry question, answer, reasoning, anchor, and status.
rationale: decision integrity is the product; injected "decisions" are the observed attack shape (ABUSE-1/2)
fit_criterion: zero rulings without a live authority anchor across the corpus incl. silence, long-session, and injected fixtures (EVAL-2; zero-tolerance)
